effects: Creates an RNat account clone for the signer if none exists, and registers the signer as its own claim executor in ClaimSetupManager when the signer is not a registered executor.
For each listed project, marks all of the signer's unclaimed assigned rewards up to and including _month as claimed.
Sends the claimed amount as FLR to the signer's RNat account, which wraps it to WFLR and holds it locked/vesting (receiveRewards).
Increases the signer's rFLR balance by the claimed amount (Transfer from 0x0 to signer). The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Intent 'Claim RNat rewards' with the project ids and the 'Up to month' index as raw numbers; the claimed amount is not shown.

findings.title: claimRewards: the claimed amount comes from storage, and the month is an internal index the screen cannot convert.
findings.evidence: RNat.sol _claimRewards: `uint128 amount = rewards.assignedRewards - rewards.claimedRewards;`; _getCurrentMonth: `(block.timestamp - firstMonthStartTs) / MONTH`. Descriptor: 'Up to month' format raw, 'Project Ids' format raw.
findings.fix: No descriptor change shows the amount. You can add a label hint such as 'Up to month (index)'.

findings.title: claimRewards: rewards go to the signer's RNat account as locked WFLR, not to the wallet; the intent does not say so.
findings.evidence: RNat.sol _claimRewards: `_getOrCreateRNatAccount().receiveRewards{value: _totalAmount}(wNat, months, amounts);` Intent: 'Claim RNat rewards'.

effects: Creates an RNat account for the signer if none exists.
Burns _amount of the signer's rFLR (Transfer signer -> 0x0).
The signer's RNat account sends _amount to the signer as WFLR when _wrap is true, or as native FLR when _wrap is false (logic in RNatAccount, not in the directory).
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw RNat', Amount '1 rFLR' and 'Wrap to WFLR: true/false' as a raw boolean.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent says 'Withdraw RNat' but the signer receives FLR or WFLR, named only by a raw boolean.
findings.evidence: Descriptor withdraw: intent 'Withdraw RNat', field 'Wrap to WFLR' format raw renders 'true'. devdoc: '_wrap: If true, the tokens will be sent wrapped in WNat. If false, they will be sent as Nat.'
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Withdraw rFLR to FLR or WFLR' and map _wrap with an enum: true -> 'Receive WFLR', false -> 'Receive native FLR'.

cases.notes: Synthetic case, no mined tx. Screen shows 1 rFLR burned and wrap=true (receive 1 WFLR) only through the boolean.

effects: Creates an RNat account for the signer if none exists.
Burns the signer's whole rFLR balance (Transfer signer -> 0x0 for the returned amount).
Sends the unlocked balance plus 50% of the locked balance to the signer as WFLR or native FLR, depending on _wrap.
Burns the other 50% of the still-locked balance as a penalty (from userdoc; RNatAccount source is not in the directory).
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw all RNat, half of locked is burned' and 'Wrap to WFLR' as a raw boolean.

findings.title: withdrawAll: the balance withdrawn and the burned penalty come from storage, so no amount is shown.
findings.evidence: RNat.sol withdrawAll: `uint128 amount = _getOrCreateRNatAccount().withdrawAll(wNat, firstMonthStartTs, _wrap);` No amount parameter in calldata.

findings.title: withdrawAll: the received asset (FLR or WFLR) is shown only as a raw 'true/false' value.
findings.evidence: Descriptor withdrawAll: field 'Wrap to WFLR' format raw; case 2 renders 'false', which means native FLR.
findings.fix: Map _wrap with an enum: true -> 'Receive WFLR', false -> 'Receive native FLR'.

cases.notes: Synthetic, no mined tx. The penalty burn and the native payout are stated; the amounts come from storage.

effects: Creates an RNat account for the signer if none exists.
Replaces all claim executors of the signer's RNat account in ClaimSetupManager with _executors, plus the signer as owner-executor.
Sends msg.value (native FLR) through the RNat account to ClaimSetupManager as the executor fee.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set reward claim executors', each executor address, and 'Executor fee' as the native value in FLR.

findings.title: setClaimExecutors: previous executors are removed; the intent 'Set' implies the replacement but does not state it.
findings.evidence: devdoc setClaimExecutors: '_executors: The new executors. All old executors will be deleted and replaced by these.' Intent: 'Set reward claim executors'.

cases.notes: Synthetic, no mined tx. The 1 FLR fee and the executor are shown.

effects: The signer must be the project's distributor; nothing of the signer's own assets moves.
Assigns _amountsWei[i] rFLR rewards for _month of _projectId to each _recipients[i], to be claimed later, and uses up the project's monthly assigned budget.
formats.shown: Intent 'Distribute project rewards', raw project id and month, then each recipient paired with its rFLR amount.

findings.title: distributeRewards: project id and month are internal indexes shown raw; no format can name them.
findings.evidence: RNat.sol distributeRewards: `Project storage project = _getProject(_projectId);` and `currentMonth == _month + 1`. Descriptor: 'Project Id' and 'Month' format raw.

cases.notes: Synthetic, no mined tx. No signer asset moves; the recipient/amount pairs are shown bundled.

couldNotCheck: RNatAccount library (clone target at RNat.libraryAddress) is not in the directory. It holds the logic of withdraw, withdrawAll (50% locked penalty), receiveRewards and setClaimExecutors that moves the signer's WFLR/FLR.
ClaimSetupManager (called by RNatAccount.setClaimExecutors with msg.value) is not in the directory, so the handling of the executor fee and executor rights could not be checked.

withdraw(uint128 _amount, bool _wrap).worst: withdraw: the intent says 'Withdraw RNat' but the signer receives FLR or WFLR, named only by a raw boolean.

withdrawAll(bool _wrap).worst: withdrawAll: the received asset (FLR or WFLR) is shown only as a raw 'true/false' value.
